content: You are Grok Build running in a terminal. Edit files only when asked.
The invoice export endpoint takes 4 seconds. Find the hot path.
Profiling the export handler first: it looks like a per-row query loop.
1831 queries for 1830 rows: the loop queries each customer. Batching it into one IN clause should cut this to about 120 ms.
Check whether the export streams rows, because a batch load changes memory use.
